describe.description: The creature is a four-legged equid shown in full right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, with a donkey-like body and head combined with zebra-like striping. Its coat is dusty brown-gray with a pale off-white underbelly and muzzle, and dark brown to black stripes across the hindquarters, back, sides, neck, chest and legs. It has a slender, slightly sway-backed torso, a long neck, a donkey-shaped head with a white nose and mouth area, two large upright ears, a short stiff upright mane along the top of the neck, four slender legs ending in single hooves, and a thin tail with a dark tuft at the tip. The rendering is detailed and naturalistic with fine fur texture.

describe.description: A slender four-legged equid shown in right-facing side profile with a donkey-like build. It has a brown-gray shaggy coat with a white belly and white muzzle, long upright ears, a short erect dark mane along the neck, faint dark striping on the hindquarters, shoulders and legs, four long thin legs ending in single dark hooves, and a thin tail with a dark tuft. It stands on all four legs against a plain light background.
